reviewer: independent visual reviewer (Claude subagent), 2026-11-21; did not author assets
method: ffmpeg -fps_mode passthrough extraction of frames 150-1160 from SOURCE and RENDER into /tmp/rv_review (frame index = filename number); side-by-side crops y650-1290 (y860-1060 for SH005/SH017) inspected visually with Read; per-frame change counts (pixels with max-channel delta >40) to locate change events in each video; column-profile cross-correlation for SH005/SH017 strip x-offset; pixel sampling of background.
global_defects: Background colour mismatch on every frame: source RGB(253,253,253), render RGB(251,251,251)
Sprite PNGs are 137-290 px and upscaled in render: softer edges and visible hairline outline seams (e.g. dollar sign right bowl x~595,y~980; man_brown hair outline breaks)

Motion-cadence phase differs: in every moving span the source holds a duplicate frame at n mod 5 == 2 while the render holds at n mod 5 == 0 (e.g. src static 162/167/172, render static 160/165/170), so in-between positions differ frame-by-frame
